NORTH CENTRAL PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
Appointments made by the Hon. Governor of North Central Provincial Council

BY virtue of the power vested under Section 32(a) of the Provincial Council Act, No. 42 of 1987, Hon. Sarath Ekanayake,the Governor of the North Central Province, do hereby notify that the officers, names mentioned below have been appointnedfor the posts North Central Provincial Council Services.

01.Mrs. Thejani Thilakerathne, Officer in Special Grade of Sri Lanka Administrative Service as the DeputySecretary (Admin.) of the Chief Ministry of North Central Province with effect from 28.01.2019.

02.Mr. W. A. R. Wimalasiri, Officer in Special Grade of Sri Lanka Administrative Service (retired) as the Secretaryof the Proivincial Public Service Commission of North Central Province for 03 months with effect from11.03.2019 to 10.06.2019 on contract basis.

03.Mr. Ananda Kularathne, Officer in Special Grade of Sri Lanka Administrative Service (retired) as the Secretaryof the Chief Ministry of North Central Province for 02 months with effect from 01.07.2019 untill 31.08.2019on contract basis.

04.Mr. P. K. Jayalath, Officer in Special Grade of Sri Lanka Administrative Service as the Secretary of theMinistry of Provincial Lands, Irrigation, Highways, Rural Development, House and Women Affairs of NorthCentral Provincial Council with effect from 17.05.2019 untill 31.08.2019 on contract basis.

06.Mr. A. K. N. Wickramasinghe, Officer in Special Grade of Sri Lanka Administrative Service as the Secretaryof the Governor of North Central Province with effect from 01.09.2019.

07.Mr. E. M. P. Ekanayake, Officer in Special Grade of Sri Lanka Administrative Service as the Secretary of theMinistry of Provincial Lands, Irrigation, Highways, Rural Development, House and Women Affairs of NorthCentral Provincial Council with effect from 01.09.2019.

08.Mr. E. W. N. A. Egodawela, Officer in Special Grade of Sri Lanka Administrative Service as the SecretaryPublic Service Commission of North Central Province with effect from 12.09.2019 to 22.10.2019.

09.Mr. R. M. R. Rathnayake, Officer in Special Grade of Sri Lanka Administrative Service as the Secretary of theProvincial Public Service Commission of North Central Province with effect from 23.10.2019.

10.Mr. E. W. N. A. Egodawela , Officer in Special Grade of Sri Lanka Administrative Service as the Secretary ofthe Ministry of Agriculture, Agro Production Marketing, Animal Production and Fisheries with effect from23.10.2019.
11.Mr. S. K. Somarathne, Officer in Grade III of Sri Lanka Administrative Service for acting as the Director ofSports of North Central Province with effect from 01.02.2019.

12.Mrs. T. A. Pathirage, Officer in Grade III of Sri Lanka Administrative Service to perform duties as theCommissioner of Co-operative Development and the Registrar of the North Central Province with effectfrom 01.02.2019.
13.Mrs. R. S. P. N. Gunawardhana , Officer in Grade III of Sri Lanka Administrative Service for acting as theCommissioner of Motor Traffic of the North Central Province with effect from 10.07.2019.

14.Mr. D. P. D. N. K. Gunasekara, Officer in Grade III of Sri Lanka Administrative Service as the Secretary ofthe Co-operative Service Commission of the North Central Province with effect from 14.09.2019.

15.Mr. K. G. S. P. Weerakoon, Officer in Grade I of Sri Lanka Accountants Service acting as the Director(Accounts and Payment) of the Treasury of the North Central Province with effect from 06.06.2019.
A. K. N. WICKRAMASINGHE,Secretary of the Governor of North Central Province.
